title: Guidelines on generative AI in research get their largest update
dek: The ERA Living Guidelines for researchers, research organisations and funders were updated on the same day the first 13 EOSC nodes went live.
key_facts: ERA Living Guidelines on the responsible use of generative AI in research
First 13 nodes of the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) went live
body: The European Commission published the largest update so far of the ERA Living Guidelines on the responsible use of generative AI in research, the shared recommendations for researchers, research organisations and funders.
On the same day, the first 13 nodes of the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) went live, expanding access to research data and digital services across Europe.
why: Evaluators and funders increasingly expect applicants to explain how they use generative AI responsibly. Aligning a proposal's methodology and data management plan with these guidelines is a simple way to avoid weaknesses in the implementation criterion.
